title: Jewels and Stones
description: You are given two strings: `jewels` representing the distinct types of stones that are jewels, and `stones` representing the stones you have. Letters are case-sensitive (`'a'` and `'A'` are different types). Return how many characters in `stones` are also present in `jewels`.
constraints: jewels and stones consist of English letters.
All characters in jewels are unique.
hints: Store all characters of jewels in a fast lookup structure (a 128-element boolean array or hash set).
Count how many characters of stones are marked in the lookup table.

examples.explanation: One 'a' and two 'A's appear in "aAAbbbb", totaling 3.
Lowercase 'z' does not match uppercase 'Z', so 0.
Every stone in "abcABC" is a jewel.
